question: A family consisting of D, P, W, Y and M is travelling to meet one another. W is travelling with his daughters, D and P. M is travelling with his maternal grandmother, Y. D is the mother of M. How is Y related to P?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64f83eb778ed58b0e6573f7e5c8d77670db9a96552265e8f9ed615b282712169.png] ​

As per the given information, the family tree is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2a92956cd9e0c35104c714f89eb40b701fabd279e0d5744477865e7721740f6.png] 

Here, Y is the **mother** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
